name: engram-probe
description: Dev probe (part of #3362): measures what thinking-keyed ENGRAM recall would surface at each model step. Observe-only; changes nothing the model reads during the turn.

minQueryChars.title: Min query chars
minQueryChars.description: Thinking-proxy arms (A, B, C, E) run only when the proxy material (thinking, or the answer text in visible mode) has at least this many chars; a step with no proxy material and no tool arguments, or a terminal step, gets a skipped row and no arm runs.

minThinkingChars.title: Min thinking chars (deprecated alias)
minThinkingChars.description: Old name of minQueryChars; used when minThinkingChars is set and minQueryChars is at its default (0).

querySource.title: Query material
querySource.description: thinking | visible (the proxy arms thinking_tail, extract_model and novel_terms use the answer text only; arm D keeps the tool arguments) | auto (thinking when long enough, else visible). thinking_full and narration_full ignore it: they always read the thinking and the answer text.

arms.title: Arms
arms.description: Comma list of arms to run: thinking_full (thinking only), narration_full (answer text only), thinking_tail, extract_model, tool_input, novel_terms. The thinking / narration / tool-argument pilot is thinking_full,narration_full,tool_input.

extractModel.title: Arm C model
extractModel.description: Model for the extract_model arm, the only arm that sends text to a side model: its input is the thinking text (thinking mode) or the step's answer text (visible mode), never tool-call arguments.

extractTimeoutMs.title: Arm C timeout (ms)
extractTimeoutMs.description: Time limit for the extract_model completion.

maxRatingChars.title: Rating request cap
maxRatingChars.description: Hard cap of the end-of-turn rating request row.

probeDir.title: Probe directory
probeDir.description: Where step/rating files go; ~ is the HOME directory.
